items.claim: Q2 2026: Alphabet published Q2 2026 results on July 22, 2026, reporting consolidated revenue of $119.80 billion (up 24% YoY) and operating income of $40.77 billion. GAAP net income was $112.19 billion ($9.11 diluted EPS) heavily distorted by a $98.0 billion net gain in Other income, while normalized EPS was approximately $2.85. Capex reached $44.92 billion resulting in negative free cash flow of -$5.86 billion, and full-year 2026 capex guidance was raised to $195.0 billion to $205.0 billion.

Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (quarter ended June 30, 2026): Two newer interim reports (Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 Form 10-Qs) have been published since the FY 2025 Form 10-K, updating financial position with significant capital expenditures and operational revenues.
U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia found Google liable for ad tech monopolization and unlawful tying, entering a behavioral injunction package.
U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California and Ninth Circuit affirmed a permanent injunction barring Google from enforcing app store exclusivity and mandatory billing tying.
General Court of the European Union annulled the European Commission's €1.49 billion AdSense Search fine.
Court of Justice of the European Union dismissed Google's final appeal, upholding the €2.42 billion fine for Google Shopping self-preferencing.
U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia found Google maintained unlawful monopolies in general search services and search text advertising, entering a remedies decree.
U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California granted final approval to a $700 million Android app antitrust settlement.
U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California class action settlement regarding Chrome Incognito tracking, requiring data destruction and privacy changes.
Autorité de la concurrence fined Google €250 million for non-compliance with related rights commitments and unannounced AI training use.
Multistate Attorneys General coalition settled geolocation tracking practices investigation for $391.5 million.
European Court of Justice dismissed final appeal and confirmed a €4.125 billion penalty against Alphabet and Google for Android mobile ecosystem restrictions.
FTC and New York AG settled COPPA violations with Google and YouTube for $170 million and mandatory COPPA compliance restructuring.
U.S. Department of Justice criminal non-prosecution agreement and $500 million forfeiture over online Canadian prescription drug advertisements.

Q2 2026: Consolidated revenues rose 24% YoY to $119.80 billion, and operating income rose 30% to $40.77 billion. Google Cloud accelerated to 82% YoY growth delivering $24.77 billion. GAAP net income rose 298% to $112.1 billion ($9.11 diluted EPS) inflated by a $98.0 to $99.0 billion net gain on equity securities.

Q2 2026: It reflects accelerating cloud growth, a surge in capital expenditures leading to negative free cash flow, and substantial unrealized equity gains impacting net income compared to annual figures.

U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Virginia ruled Google maintained illegal monopolies in publisher ad servers and ad exchanges, imposing behavioral remedies instead of forced divestiture.
U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California granted final approval to a $700 million settlement resolving Android app store antitrust claims by state attorneys general and consumers.
U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California entered a three-year permanent injunction in Epic Games v. Google prohibiting anti-steering and mandatory Play Billing.
SEC administrative proceeding resulted in a $750,000 civil monetary penalty and cease-and-desist order for reporting and disclosure failures under Sections 16(a) and 13(f).
General Court of the European Union completely annulled the €1.49 billion AdSense fine imposed by the European Commission.
Court of Justice of the European Union dismissed Alphabet's appeal, upholding the €2.424 billion fine for Google Shopping algorithmic self-preferencing.
U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia ruled that Google acted as a monopolist in general search services and text advertising.
U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California filed an injunctive settlement requiring deletion of private browsing records in the Incognito Mode deceptive tracking case.
Google entered a $391.5 million settlement with 40 state attorneys general resolving deceptive location tracking allegations.
General Court of the European Union largely upheld the European Commission's Android abuse of dominance decision, reducing the fine to €4.125 billion.
FTC and New York AG settled with Google and YouTube for a record $170 million over COPPA child privacy violations.
Google entered a criminal Non-Prosecution Agreement and forfeited $500 million for facilitating unlawful Canadian pharmacy advertisements.
